name: Split screen
summary: Show two or more pictures in one frame at the same time.
how: Divide the frame into equal cells with a 4px gap.
Use the same aspect ratio in each cell.
Keep one source of sound for the whole frame.
Mark who is in each cell with a label.

origin.note: Abel Gance uses a triple screen in Napoléon.

adoptions.via: TikTok adds Duet: the new clip plays beside an existing clip in one vertical frame.
